name: [UPD] Aura Dance Battles 🔥
desc:
👑 Aura Dance Battles

Build up your AURA, flex your best moves, and prove you’ve got the most aura in the entire server. 🔥

⚡ Face off in 1v1 Aura Battles
🕺 Unlock and equip brand-new aura moves
🗳️ Vote and let players decide who has the best aura
🏆 Win tournaments and rise as the Aura King
✨ Collect rare auras, emotes, and cosmetics
💎 Earn rewards and climb your way up the leaderboards
👑 Make it through the bracket and take the crown!

Think you have enough aura to reach #1? 😈

⭐ Favorite the game to stay tuned for future updates!

llm.loop: enter 1v1 aura dance battles -> perform aura moves -> players vote on the winner -> earn coins -> unlock auras, emotes and cosmetics -> climb tournament bracket
llm.objectives: win dance battles and tournaments to become Aura King
llm.instructions: face off in 1v1 aura battles, unlock aura moves, vote, win tournaments, collect auras
unique: server votes decide dance battle winners
llm.thumbnails: two avatars in a VS dance-off with '6 7' graphic, '1 AURA vs 999 AURA' comparison
llm.video: one page video, content not shown
llm.complexity_notes: stage, voting and bracket system, emotes and aura VFX
